hypothesis.thesis: There exists a neural architecture that learns modular addition (a + b) mod p for primes p in [5, 31] with substantially less compute than a standard 2-layer transformer, by exploiting mathematical structure intrinsic to the task rather than relying on general-purpose approximation.
hypothesis.null_hypothesis: A standard 2-layer transformer with softmax scoring trained on the same data with the same compute budget.
success_criteria: Reaches 99% test accuracy on modular addition (mod p for p in [5, 31]) using less than 50% of the baseline's compute-to-threshold
Maintains performance across all tested primes without per-prime tuning
Achieves higher test accuracy per FLOP than the baseline across the full compute budget
failure_criteria: Gradient norms exceed 50 for 3 consecutive checkpoints
Test accuracy does not exceed 60% after consuming 50% of the compute budget
Loss does not decrease below initial loss after consuming 20% of the compute budget
references: Murray 2023 - Phase codes in RNNs for modular arithmetic (arXiv:2310.07908)
Bronstein et al 2021 - Geometric Deep Learning (arXiv:2104.13478)

shuffled_labels.explanation: Shuffled-label model achieved 0.0149 test accuracy — near random. Architecture does NOT memorize without label structure.

baseline_comparison.explanation: Candidate exceeds baseline on primary metric and wins all 4 secondary metrics.

details.explanation: All 5 seeds achieved 100% test accuracy with zero variance, well within tolerance of 0.15.

judge.reasoning: All five criteria pass unambiguously. The candidate achieves 100% test accuracy across all 9 primes with 160 parameters (vs baseline's 405,023 parameters at 45.3% accuracy after exhausting the full 10,000-epoch budget). It reaches threshold in 1% of the compute budget. All three null-baseline comparisons pass. Reproducibility is perfect — all 5 seeds reach 1.0 accuracy with zero variance.

test_accuracy_modular_addition.improvement: 100% vs 45.3% — candidate achieves perfect accuracy; baseline plateaus below 50% after full budget

compute_to_threshold_ratio.improvement: Candidate reached 99% threshold at epoch 100 (1% of budget); baseline never reached threshold in 10,000 epochs

samples_to_threshold_accuracy.improvement: Candidate reached threshold after 166,800 samples; baseline never reached threshold after 16,680,000 samples

gradient_health_mean_norm.improvement: Both healthy; candidate's meaningful gradients (0.027) indicate active learning vs baseline's near-zero (0.006) suggesting overfit stagnation

param_efficiency_params_per_accuracy_poi.improvement: 5,586x more parameter-efficient — 160 params at 100% vs 405,023 params at 45.3%

geometric (torus_rotation_compositor).reason: Diminishing returns: v2 (K=16, 99.7%) worse than v1 (K=32, 99.94%) with gradient instability

signal (harmonic_phase_correlator).reason: Depth ceiling: 100% accuracy at depth 2, theoretical maximum reached

info-theory (syndrome_refinement_decoder.reason: Pareto dominated by signal class (100% acc, 160 params vs 98.6% acc, 79,808 params)

accuracy_trajectory.note: Random init — above-chance due to architectural inductive bias
3 primes (5, 11, 17) not yet at 100% — confirms learning, not init-encoding
All 9 primes at 100%; threshold reached at 1% of budget

leading_candidate.mechanism: Phase correlation via complex multiplication of Fourier components — discrete Fourier analysis of modular addition structure
